api_token.description: Cherry Servers [API Key](https://portal.cherryservers.com/settings/api-keys) that allows interactions with the API.

a_record.description: Relative DNS name for the IP address. Resulting FQDN will be '<relative-dns-name>.cloud.cherryservers.net' and must be globally unique.

a_record_effective.description: Relative DNS name for the IP address. Resulting FQDN will be '<relative-dns-name>.cloud.cherryservers.net' and must be globally unique.API return value.

address.description: The IP address in canonical format used in the reverse DNS record.

address_family.description: IP address family IPv4 or IPv6.

cidr.description: The CIDR block of the IP.

project_id.description: CherryServers project id, associated with the IP.

ptr_record.description: Reverse DNS name for the IP address.

ptr_record_effective.description: Reverse DNS name for the IP address. API return value.

region.description: Slug of the region. Example: LT-Siauliai [See List Regions](https://api.cherryservers.com/doc/#tag/Regions/operation/get-regions).

target_hostname.description: The hostname of the server to which the IP is attached.Conflicts with target_id and target_ip_id.

target_id.description: The ID of the server to which the IP is attached.Conflicts with target_hostname and target_ip_id.

target_ip_id.description: Subnet or primary-ip type IP ID to route the created IP to.Conflicts with target_hostname and target_id.

block.description: Provides a CherryServers IP resource. This can be used to create, modify, and delete IP addresses.

enabled.description: BGP is enabled for the project.

local_asn.description: The local ASN of the project.

team_id.description: The ID of the team that owns the project.

allow_reinstall.description: Allow server re-installation when updating `image`, `ssh_key_ids`, `os_partition_size` or `user_data`. WARNING: The reinstall will be triggered even if Terraform reports an in-place update. Server private IP may change on re-install.

cycle.description: Server billing cycle slug. Default is 'hourly.

extra_ip_addresses_ids.description: Set of the IP address IDs to be embedded into the server.

image.description: Slug of the server operating system. Updating this attribute requires a server re-install.

address_family.description: Address family of the IP address.

ip_addresses.description: IP addresses attached to the server.

ip_addresses_ids.description: **Deprecated**.Set of the IP address IDs to be embedded into the server.

os_partition_size.description: OS partition size in GB. Updating this attribute requires a server re-install.

plan.description: Slug of the plan. Example: e5_1620v4. [See List Plans](https://api.cherryservers.com/doc/#tag/Plans/operation/get-plans).

power_state.description: The power state of the server, such as 'Powered off' or 'Powered on'.

project_id.description: ID of the project to which the server belongs.

region.description: Slug of the region. Example: LT-Siauliai [See List Regions](https://api.cherryservers.com/doc/#tag/Regions/operation/get-regions).

spot_instance.description: If True, provisions the server as a spot instance.

ssh_key_ids.description: Set of the SSH key IDs allowed to SSH to the server. Updating this attribute requires a server re-install.

state.description: The state of the server, such as 'pending' or 'active'.

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

update.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

user_data.description: Base64 encoded user-data blob. It should be a bash or cloud-config script. Updating this attribute requires a server re-install.
